integrity.provenance_note: Mathematical statements and computations are presented as research results, without a claim of publication or independent certification.

limitations: No claim of ergodicity, mixing, an optimal discrepancy exponent, or simple formulas for every cylinder probability. The original paper establishes recurrence and the factor language, while the present proof establishes all-factor quantitative frequency convergence and positivity.
title: Positive factor frequencies and polylogarithmic discrepancy in Brik's word
